about_the_game:
YOU ARE A MONSTER

Risen from the dead by a mystical plant, you are a ghoul possessing power and consciousness. Lost but not afraid, something beckons you to descend the Dungeon. Answers can be found below, but the Dungeon itself will try to stop you. Do not let it.

Replace your appendages, level your stats, and acquire upgrades. Help the few strangers within, or use them as stepping stones. Become the type of monster you want to be, as the choices you make affect your journey into the depths below.

KEY FEATURES

  • Dynamic Dungeon. Handcrafted rooms stitched together into randomly generated runs!

  • Strange Strangers. Interact with a multitude of odd characters who can help and/or hinder you!

  • Evolve. Discover and use 30+ unique upgrades with different synergies!

  • Craft the Perfect Body. Swap limbs and manage 8 core stats to be the best version of your ghoulish self!

  • Enemy Variety. Encounter and eliminate over 10+ unique enemies and bosses!

  • Darker Secrets. Uncover secrets hidden within the chambers of the Dungeon!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains fantasy violence, blood, consumption of corpses, and replacing of limbs.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 128 MB VRAM, DirectX 11 compatible
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 512 MB VRAM, DirectX 11 compatible

short_description: Descend a living dungeon in this ghoulish Action Roguelike RPG. Devour enemies, replace appendages, and use strange upgrades. Encounter powerful foes, uncertain allies, and hidden secrets. Embrace your monstrous nature, or try to resist it.
